title: Merchant has received the return but the refund review has not started
snapshot: Tallowmere Goods' warehouse issued inline receipt WH-035 for return RT-035 / TG-035 at 08:10 UTC, but its receiving role does not approve refunds and no refund review exists. Melli Orven asks the desk to pass the receipt to the team that handles refunds.
recorded_action: Iona Quill emailed the Refunds team, Tallowmere Goods, asking it to register the refund review for TG-035 / RT-035 with WH-035 and to send the case reference and next update date.

negatives.label: Review form errors on receipt upload

new_event.text: Automated notice. Your message about TG-035 reached the refunds mailbox, but the review form returned error RVW-422 when attaching WH-035. The notice cannot show whether a review case was saved.

negatives.expected_action: Email the Refunds team and ask whether a review is registered for TG-035 with WH-035, stating that the request will not be resubmitted until it answers.
negatives.must_not: Do not resubmit or tell Melli a review has started; a second submission can open two reviews on one return.
negatives.done_means: The Refunds team confirms one registered review, or none and one resubmission confirmed once; a registered review is not an approved refund or payment.

agent_event.text: Your 09:31 notice shows error RVW-422 when attaching WH-035 to the TG-035 review form. Please check whether a review is registered for TG-035 / RT-035 with WH-035, and send its reference if so. We will not resubmit until you confirm.

followup_event.text: No review was saved before the RVW-422 error. We have registered one review, RF-035, with WH-035 for TG-035 / RT-035 and will update the order thread by 2026-03-10, 16:00 UTC. Registration is not approval; eligibility, amount and payment are undecided.

negatives.label: Refunds record shows return not received

new_event.text: Our order record for TG-035 shows RT-035 as not received and holds no WH-035. We register reviews only against a receipt posted to the order. We have not opened a review.

negatives.expected_action: Email Warehouse receiving, Tallowmere Goods, with both records, its inline receipt WH-035 from 08:10 and the refunds record showing RT-035 not received, and ask it to confirm whether WH-035 is posted to the TG-035 order record.
negatives.must_not: Do not ask the Refunds team to treat the desk's copy of WH-035 as posted, and do not tell Melli the return is missing.
negatives.done_means: Warehouse receiving confirms whether WH-035 is posted so the Refunds team can register against it; neither record is overwritten, and registration would still not be refund approval.

agent_event.text: Two records disagree for RT-035. Your inline receipt WH-035 shows it physically received at 08:10 UTC today. The Refunds team's order record for TG-035 shows RT-035 not received and holds no WH-035, so it cannot register a review. Please confirm whether WH-035 is posted to the TG-035 order record.

followup_event.text: WH-035 was recorded at the returns bay at 08:10 but had not posted to the TG-035 order record. It posted at 10:40, so the Refunds team can now register against it. Posting confirms receipt only; it is not a review or refund approval.

negatives.label: Receiving team marks refund approved

new_event.text: We saw your note to refunds. To speed things up we have marked the TG-035 refund as approved on our receiving screen. The customer can be told it is approved.

negatives.expected_action: Reply to Warehouse receiving that the desk will not relay any approval, and keep the request with the Refunds team, Tallowmere Goods, asking it to state the review's actual status.
negatives.must_not: Do not tell Melli the refund is approved; Warehouse receiving stated in event 001 that its role does not approve refunds.
negatives.done_means: The Refunds team states whether a review exists and what it has decided; a receiving-screen flag is not an approval, and no payment is shown.

agent_event.to: Warehouse receiving, Tallowmere Goods; Refunds team, Tallowmere Goods
agent_event.text: Warehouse receiving: we will not relay any refund approval to the customer; your 09:00 note says the receiving role does not approve refunds. Refunds team: our 09:25 request to register the review for TG-035 / RT-035 with WH-035 stands. Please state the actual status of that review.

followup_event.text: No refund approval exists for TG-035; a receiving-screen flag cannot approve one and has been cleared. Review RF-035 is registered with WH-035, and eligibility, amount and payment are undecided. Next update by 2026-03-10, 16:00 UTC.

negatives.label: Customer asks to confirm amount and approval

new_event.text: I can see RF-035 now. My bank needs written confirmation. Please confirm the refund of GBP 89.00 is approved and will be paid this week.

negatives.expected_action: Reply to Melli in the Customer portal that RF-035 is registered with WH-035, that the Refunds team has not decided eligibility, amount or payment, and that its next update is due by 2026-03-10, 16:00 UTC.
negatives.must_not: Do not confirm GBP 89.00, an approval or a payment week, and do not ask the Refunds team to decide early.
negatives.done_means: Melli acknowledges the registered status and update date; nothing about eligibility, amount or payment is established.

agent_event.text: We cannot confirm an approval, an amount or a payment date. Review RF-035 is registered with warehouse receipt WH-035, but the Tallowmere Goods Refunds team has not decided eligibility, amount or payment. Its next update is due by 2026-03-10, 16:00 UTC. Only that team can give your bank a decision.

followup_event.text: Understood. I will tell my bank that review RF-035 is registered and the next update is due by 2026-03-10, 16:00 UTC. I accept that approval, amount and payment are not decided yet.

negatives.label: Customer wants the item back instead

new_event.text: I have changed my mind. I would rather have the item back than a refund. Please stop the refund review for TG-035.

negatives.expected_action: Email the Refunds team to record Melli's stop on the review request for TG-035, ask it to register nothing further, and ask whether a review was already opened.
negatives.must_not: Do not ask the warehouse to send the item back to Melli; returning a received item is a new merchant decision, not part of the stop.
negatives.done_means: The Refunds team confirms the stop and the state of any review; the item is still with Tallowmere, and sending it back is a separate request for the merchant.

agent_event.text: At 09:45 the customer asked us to stop our 09:25 refund review request for TG-035 and would now prefer the item back. Please register nothing further on our request and tell us whether a review was already opened. Returning the item would be a separate request for Tallowmere to decide.

followup_event.text: Stop recorded against your 09:25 request. No review had been opened for TG-035, and none will be registered on it. The item remains in our returns stock under WH-035. Sending it back to the customer needs a separate merchant decision; nothing is decided on that.

negatives.label: Phone call opens a second review

new_event.text: A second review, RF-035-B, was opened at 10:05 from the customer's phone call, also citing WH-035. TG-035 now has two open reviews. Please confirm how to proceed.

negatives.expected_action: Reply to the Refunds team that RF-035-B duplicates RF-035 for the same receipt WH-035, and ask it to link RF-035-B to RF-035 and keep RF-035 as the single review.
negatives.must_not: Do not leave both reviews open; two reviews on one receipt can lead to two decisions or two payments.
negatives.done_means: The Refunds team confirms RF-035-B is closed and RF-035 continues with its update due by 2026-03-10, 16:00 UTC; nothing is approved or paid.

agent_event.text: RF-035-B duplicates RF-035: both concern TG-035 and the same receipt, WH-035. Please link RF-035-B to RF-035, close it, and keep RF-035 as the single review. Please confirm once done.

followup_event.text: RF-035-B is closed and linked to RF-035. RF-035 is the single review for TG-035 with WH-035, and its update remains due by 2026-03-10, 16:00 UTC. Nothing is approved or paid.
